title: Insurance ontology
description: Portable insurance semantics normalized from Lattice.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Ontology
metadata:
  name: insurance
  title: Insurance ontology
  description: Portable insurance semantics normalized from the Lattice generated industry ontology.
  version: 0.1.0
  source:
    system: lattice
    sourceId: insurance-ontology
    sourceVersion: 0.1.0
    sourceDigest: sha256:93226bf29c075ba5b3715b39e94d68df1d6adf68c69e4e980d9cbd90b7231a56
spec:
  types:
    - id: insurance_policy
      label: Insurance Policy
      description: A governed contract of insurance and its period and terms.
      properties:
        - id: insurance_policy.policy_number
          label: Policy Number
          dataType: string
          identifier: true
          description: Policy number.
        - id: insurance_policy.policy_provisions_cited
          label: Policy Provisions Cited
          dataType: string
          description: Policy provisions, exclusions, or conditions cited.
        - id: insurance_policy.policy_period_start
          label: Policy Period Start
          dataType: date
        - id: insurance_policy.policy_period_end
          label: Policy Period End
          dataType: date
    - id: insured_party
      label: Insured Party
      description: A person or organization protected by an insurance policy.
      properties:
        - id: insured_party.named_insured
          label: Named Insured
          dataType: string
          required: true
        - id: insured_party.insured_name
          label: Insured Name
          dataType: string
        - id: insured_party.claimant_name
          label: Claimant Name
          dataType: string
    - id: insurance_claim
      label: Insurance Claim
      description: A request for coverage or payment following a loss.
      properties:
        - id: insurance_claim.claim_number
          label: Claim Number
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
        - id: insurance_claim.reported_date
          label: Reported Date
          dataType: date
        - id: insurance_claim.claim_status
          label: Claim Status
          dataType: string
          allowedValues: [open, pending, reserved, closed, denied, litigated]
        - id: insurance_claim.claim_type
          label: Claim Type
          dataType: string
        - id: insurance_claim.reserve_amount
          label: Reserve Amount
          dataType: decimal
          unit: USD
        - id: insurance_claim.paid_amount
          label: Paid Amount
          dataType: decimal
          unit: USD
        - id: insurance_claim.documents_received
          label: Documents Received
          dataType: array
        - id: insurance_claim.next_action_due_date
          label: Next Action Due Date
          dataType: date
    - id: loss_event
      label: Loss Event
      description: An occurrence that may trigger insurance coverage.
      properties:
        - id: loss_event.loss_date
          label: Loss Date
          dataType: date
        - id: loss_event.loss_location
          label: Loss Location
          dataType: string
        - id: loss_event.loss_description
          label: Loss Description
          dataType: string
        - id: loss_event.loss_cause
          label: Loss Cause
          dataType: string
        - id: loss_event.loss_history_summary
          label: Loss History Summary
          dataType: string
        - id: loss_event.estimated_loss_amount
          label: Estimated Loss Amount
          dataType: decimal
          unit: USD
        - id: loss_event.injury_indicator
          label: Injury Indicator
          dataType: boolean
    - id: coverage
      label: Coverage
      description: A governed coverage grant, limit, exclusion, or position.
      properties:
        - id: coverage.coverage_analysis
          label: Coverage Analysis
          dataType: string
          required: true
        - id: coverage.coverage_position
          label: Coverage Position
          dataType: string
          allowedValues: [accepted, reservation-of-rights, denied, pending]
        - id: coverage.coverage_limits
          label: Coverage Limits
          dataType: string
    - id: insurance_organization
      label: Insurance Organization
      description: A carrier, producer, or adjusting organization.
      properties:
        - id: insurance_organization.carrier_name
          label: Carrier Name
          dataType: string
          required: true
        - id: insurance_organization.adjuster_name
          label: Adjuster Name
          dataType: string
    - id: claim_adjustment
      label: Claim Adjustment
      description: A governed valuation and recommended disposition of a claim.
      properties:
        - id: claim_adjustment.adjuster_name
          label: Adjuster Name
          dataType: string
        - id: claim_adjustment.recommended_reserve
          label: Recommended Reserve
          dataType: decimal
          unit: USD
        - id: claim_adjustment.recommended_payment
          label: Recommended Payment
          dataType: decimal
          unit: USD
        - id: claim_adjustment.open_items
          label: Open Items
          dataType: array
  relationships:
    - id: covers
      label: COVERS
      sourceTypeId: insurance_policy
      targetTypeId: insured_party
      cardinality: many-to-many
    - id: issued_by
      label: ISSUED_BY
      sourceTypeId: insurance_policy
      targetTypeId: insurance_organization
      cardinality: many-to-many
    - id: governs
      label: GOVERNS
      sourceTypeId: insurance_policy
      targetTypeId: insurance_claim
      cardinality: many-to-many
    - id: arises_from
      label: ARISES_FROM
      sourceTypeId: insurance_claim
      targetTypeId: loss_event
      cardinality: many-to-many
    - id: evaluated_as
      label: EVALUATED_AS
      sourceTypeId: insurance_claim
      targetTypeId: claim_adjustment
      cardinality: many-to-many
    - id: contains
      label: CONTAINS
      sourceTypeId: insurance_policy
      targetTypeId: coverage
      cardinality: many-to-many
